items.title: Inside the Operation That Helped Ukraine Reverse Some Russian War Gains

items.content: <article>After months of secrecy, Ukrainian commanders let New York Times journalists join them in bunkers and training grounds used to reverse some Russian territorial gains.</article>

items.title: What to Expect From Lame-Duck Trump
items.content: <article>“When he feels cornered, when he feels attacked, he fights back,” the columnist Carlos Lozada says of Donald Trump, who is now entering the lame-duck phase of his presidency. Columnists from across Times Opinion share their predictions for what the final two years of Trump’s term might look like — and they’re not pretty.</article>
